text:
Predicates:
ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
American(x) ::: x is an American national.
CanDoJumpShots(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
LeapsIntoAir(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
ActivatesLegMuscles(x) ::: x activates his leg muscles.
Yuri ::: Yuri

Premises:
∃x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬American(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) → CanDoJumpShots(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (CanDoJumpShots(x) → LeapsIntoAir(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, then they leap straight into the air.
∀x (LeapsIntoAir(x) → ActivatesLegMuscles(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, then they activate their leg muscles.
¬ActivatesLegMuscles(Yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.

Conclusion:
(¬LeapsIntoAir(Yuri)) → (American(Yuri) ∧ ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(Yuri))
